mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 48 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park, though please note an elevated air quality alert is in effect.

The Verona Senior Center has officially earned accreditation from the Wisconsin Association of Senior Centers for their work in promoting healthy aging, and the city is also reviewing several development projects for the upcoming Plan Commission meeting.

There is plenty to do in town with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both taking place today, followed by a busy Wednesday tomorrow featuring pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and live music at Paddy Mac's.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department made an arrest after a report of dangerous driving involving a school bus, where the driver was subsequently charged with O W I.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Devil's Food Cake, and you can head over to enjoy it now since the restaurant is open until 10 PM tonight.
